rescueTalk: This way. Follow me.
Damn it, they've ravaged this land.
Water... I need water.
They won't let us go!
You are my saviors!
Help! Get me out of this place!
They smashed my car!
You're not zombies, are you?
Can we still make it out alive?
Are you sure you don't want to come in and hide?
What are they? Monsters?
Help! Get me out of this place!
We must not fall here!
This is terrifying! Get me out of this hell!
Watch out, Monsters can appear from any direction.
Can I have a clean pair of pants?
Maybe I can join the fight too.
What a disaster, I'm really not the culprit.
I'm really scared!
They must be eradicated, but I can't do it.
I took these, and no one should notice.
I'm the only one left.
Did you receive my distress signal?
Didn't expect anyone to make it here.
Be careful, I can sense them approaching.
This place is terrifying! I need to get out of here.
I'm taking all of these with me.
Can you help me fix the circuits here?
Watch out! There are many Monsters.
Hide quickly! They'll find us!
Can we still make it out alive?
Hallucinations, I must be seeing things.
Let me join you!
In my youth, I could take on ten at once.
Shh, keep it down.
Please get me out of here! I beg you!
My research is about to succeed!
I'm a doctor. Please let me join you.
Slow down, my legs are still shaking.
I know some basic first aid.
You seem injured. Let me heal you.
Do not enter the lab!
They turned this place into a living hell.
Wait for me, I'm scared.
Don't turn on the light yet. They'll notice us!
Monsters! They're everywhere!
Monsters! They're everywhere!
Finally... we'er saved.
